question: Across 2022 through 2025, in which year did Exxon Mobil earn the most net income attributable to ExxonMobil, and how far below that peak was 2025?
answer: Exxon Mobil earned the most net income attributable to ExxonMobil in 2022, with $55,740 million. In 2025, net income attributable to ExxonMobil was $28,844 million, which was $26,896 million below the 2022 peak.
